query: How can businesses improve Yelp user satisfaction?

per_column.name: staff_conduct
per_column.rationale: Staff conduct is a core, actionable driver of Yelp satisfaction, giving a strong axis to group and prioritize improvements. Row evidence is well grounded: friendly/positive, dismissive (forgotten twice), rude/discriminatory nightclub, all correctly read; silent rows marked not_present.

per_column.name: value_perception
per_column.rationale: Pricing/value is a genuine satisfaction lever and adds a distinct grouping axis. Mostly grounded, though YLP-0003 tagged 'overpriced_poor_value' is a borderline read — the review only speculates about a cheaper single-serve option rather than clearly complaining of overpricing. Row 1's 'good_value_positive' (free pita) is reasonable.

per_column.name: atmosphere_ambiance_signal
per_column.rationale: Ambiance is a legitimate satisfaction dimension distinct from staff/value. Values appear conservative and grounded; row 1 rowdy-crowd could arguably be noise/crowding but not_present is not a hallucination. Silent rows correctly not_present.

per_column.name: visit_context
per_column.rationale: Visit context enables segmentation (late-night, group, first-time) that can meaningfully inform targeted improvements. Late_night for Oliveo and dine_in for lunch reviews are sound. The heavy default to 'dine_in_regular' (e.g., YLP-0002/0003 where only 'lunch' is stated) is a mild over-assertion but broadly warranted.

per_column.name: business_category
per_column.rationale: Category is highly useful for segmenting how businesses can improve satisfaction across sectors. Extractions are sound: real-estate → other_service, cabana/door policy → nightclub_bar, pizza → restaurant_food. Well grounded in text.

judge.rationale: All five added columns provide genuine, distinct analytical axes (staff, value, ambiance, context, category) directly relevant to improving Yelp satisfaction, with no near-constant or trivially redundant columns. Values are largely sound readings of the source text with appropriate not_present defaults for silent rows. Minor groundedness weaknesses are the occasional confident default (e.g., dine_in_regular, and the borderline overpriced tag on YLP-0003), but no clear invented facts or contradictions were observed.
